balls.text: Stunnig bowling! Near yorker. 137ks low full toss on leg, flicked through midwicket. Pooran ran in and threw it on the bounce over leg stump. Pant whips off the bail... no, it was a direct hit replay shows. Five off the last over, effectively a maiden

Run-out? Direct hit missed at the non-striker's. Prince ran in follow-through towards cover and threw. Was a low full toss on leg that Jansen tried to whip leg side, inside edge onto pad and deflects away

Good catch at mid-on, Markram jumps at falls back after catching it with both hands. Held on with the right. Prince's prayerbration returns. Looked like Shashank read the slower one there, 119ks just outside off, he pulled hard but got it off the upper-half
Wide and full, scythed to deep square leg
Short and slow on the waist, pulled off the waist to deep fine leg. Shashank wanted to help it away, had no pace to work with
Okay, yorkers in. Actually a full toss right over the front show, Stoinis clears it out the way and flicks to deep square leg. 250 up
First yorker attempted in the over, missed and duly flicked away off the feet. In the gap through backward square leg
No bounce and that's eased away. Touch sarcastic but what else can you say about such an effortless pull! Taken from outside off after walking across, from thigh-height, sails over wide long-on
Shashank walks with the ball, it's close to the return crease... and is called wide. Shami going short and into the pitch again
Back of a length outside off, same as last but with a bit more room, cut to deep cover

Stoinis walked across after pulling, felt at first that it might be because he thought he didn't get enough. Well, it was enough all right, well straight of long-on and flat over the fence. Shami going into the pitch and outside off again

This was misjudgement from Stoinis. He realises straightaway. Lets the 135ks shortish ball go, it's around shoulder-height and well within the tramline. Shami gets away with it. Maybe it's just a good ball in the phase

Another wide... No. Not called. Stoinis chats with Shashank and reviews. Would it be an innings without one of those? He was outside the tramline a touch before the release. The offcutter was on a back of length and finished... right on the revised wide guideline. Review lost.
Did Stoinis walk across too early? No. He lets go the short ball that's wanged from a 11'o clock angle. Goes away from the batter who leaves it
Wide and short, called an extra. 131ks around the tramline, Stoinis stood still and reached out for the cut, missed it

Slip, tumble, deflection... just a dot. Sigh. Was a yorker outside off, Shashank made room and reached out for the cover drive. Back leg slipped as the inside edge took the ball to Pant's left. He threw, missed. The bowler was hit and it deflected away, not far though
Same length but this one cants in to the base of the back leg, Stoinis misses the flick. The ball deflects towards square leg, bowler chases to keep it to one
Slot enough, the attempted yorker is well in front of the crease and Stoinis chomps it through the line. Bat face turns inside, ball still flies over the bowler
Wide... No, not given. Slower bouncer just outside off, Stoinis let it go. Around head-high if not over
Boundary board needs to watch out. That is as flat as sixes get. Back of length just outside off, Stoinis stands upright, uses his strong yet flexible torso to swivel hard and pull it wide of long-on
Edge goes through the vacant first-slip area. Not much room, Stoinis went after the length ball. Looked to slap it over cover, thickest of outside edges goes fine
Shankyyy! No shanking, middles it first ball. Drives the middle-stump length ball through the line, it's slightly on the rise but don't matter. Just clears the cushion

Pooran runs across to the left and takes it at deep midwicket. Bread-basket catch, threw the ball back as though he was just fielding. Wadhera flung his bat up, spinning his frustration away. Length ball outside off, pulled across the line
This time, it's all skill. Remarkable just how fine he got it. Wadhera getting a little too far inside the line and sweeps the low full toss late

Batter's game this. Wadhera, like Connolly earlier, went too far across. This time just outside and he looked to sweep the low full toss on middle, gloved it fine. Pant and Sid think of the review, won't take it. Good call
Bowler's game this. Thigh-high full toss outside off and it's slapped straight to long-off

Flat yorker on leg, clipped softly towards square leg. Went off the boot, Pant chased and looked to keep Wadhera in check with a throw, hit low on the back of the leg. Wadhera springs his leg forward, that'll hurt. Takes a minute but is okay
Slow and full outside off, defended towards point
Length on off, worked back to the bowler
Nudged towards cover. Length ball on middle, that'd have travelled three overs ago
Pitched up outside off, 140ks, square driven to deep point

Three quick wickets before PBKS reach 200. 127ks, angling away again. Shreyas looked to drive the fullish length ball inside out over extra cover again. He's a touch too late on it this time and outside edges it to short third. Impressive from Mohsin as that was slow but still hurried the batter
Slower one beats the extra-cover drive. 122ks, fullish and angling away. Shreyas wanted to aerial
Cover point beaten, backward point... not. Dives to the right and stops with both hands. Was a flat yorker just outside off that was squeezed with an open face
Flat and pitched up on off, 104ks, punched off the front foot through cover. No one in the infield, deep cover runs across and stops it
Length outside off, square cut to deep point
Paddles it off a full length without following through, gets it fine and into the outfield

Priyansh is livid, yells as Marsh seems to have taken an ice-cool boundary catch at long-off. Sent upstairs by the ump. Catch taken above head as he lifted both feet, the back foot then landed... and we'll need to zoom in for this... inches within the cushion! Priyansh walks back to a rousing occasion from fans, team-mates and owners. Was a hittable slot ball angling away around off, Priyansh cleared the front leg and swung with the bat-face opening slightly. Nearly enough. He'll leave without a hundred
Full on leg, flicked through to long-on
Near yorker on middle and leg, 138ks, Shreyas looks to flick it. Gets it along the pitch and then to long-on's left

Is the party finally over? Yes! Prince prays likely in relief. Connolly looks up, sighs and walks back. Job done though. Was a 139ks pace-on, back of length ball just outside off, rose around rib-height, Connolly looked to belt it through midwicket but got a top edge that was taken at short third. Partnership ends at 182 off 80
Very low full toss, pace on, driven to deep cover
After having a word with Pant, Prince goes for the slower ball. Effective. Connolly looked to drive it straight, thick outside edge goes to deep ppoint

Smeared over cover, one-bounce four. Whatever Connolly was struggling from early on is long gone. He's so still till the point of delivery, judging the length early - which is fullish this time - and swinging as needed. This time, it's with a horizontal bat
Looks to whack it through midwicket, inside-edges it onto pad. Rolls to the bowler's left. 139ks
Make that 32! Every shot a bona-fide maximum. This one's another straight hit. Stays leg side and swings through the line. Might need to lie down to recoer from that
Smoked over deep midwicket. Priyansh toying with the bowling. Slides leg side and languidly swings across his knees and slog sweeps it over midwicket. 26 off it!
Snap, under-edge goes to deep-backward square. Looks to slog the length ball over midwicket
Darted wide from over the wicket. Too wide. The length ball goes wide of the tramline, let go
Okay, six sixes in the over is on! Connolly gets a step hit straight back. Fuller side of length at the stumps, driven through the line. 89 metres back
So high, so far! Connolly makes room and nearly gets followed, swipes across the line. The bounce on the length ball is good enough for sweet connection. Sails over long-on
Not right away. Offers a bit of width from around the wicket, Connolly stands leg side of the ball and slaps it over extra cover
Slower ball beats bat. 115ks, wide on a length, Priyansh stays still and looks to cut it square, loses his balance as the ball goes under the edge
Very full outside off, looks to drive over cover. Gets a thick edge to deep third

Connolly should've been bowled there, got far too across. Avesh saw him and looked to hit the base of leg and middle, it ended up as a really low full toss. Somehow, Connolly had enough time to set himself up and lift the ball with a scoop over fine leg
Perfect yorker on middle stump but Priyansh opens the face fully again. Stands beside it and guides it to deep third

Scythes it like a ninja. Sees the width on the wid full toss, knows it's going away from him and is close to the tramline. Keeps his wrists a touch lose, opens the face and hits it flat over backward point
Avesh offers a gift on return. Knee-roll high full toss outside off, slapped with a horizontal bat to send it high over long-on. Connolly applauds using his bat
Slicy-dicy work from Connolly. Uses the angle in from around the wicket by opening the face fully and chomping the yorker wide of short third
Slower one hits the board behind the sightscreen. Connolly's making up and has brought up fifty. Overpitched around off, Connolly's still in the crease again and drives through the line
Close to a yorker on off, driven to long-off
Pitched up on off, driven to deep point

Not the best sound off the bat but it sails over midwicket. 123ks back of length offcutter on top of middle and off, Connolly stands upright and swings across his hips right as the ball comes in front of him
Pitched up on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Great stop at backward point. This was a low full toss angled across, he flashes a drive and hits it hard behind point. Siddharth dives to his left to make that stop
Looks for the yorker on leg, clipped away through square leg
Very full outside off, driven back hard to the bowler, who looks like he's injured his right hand trying to stop that. Was a slower ball, and it hits him high on the palm
That's the longer boundary, but it matters not. Dug in short, with width on offer, and Arya slaps it away over point
Yorker outside off, he looks to jam his bat down but no contact
Full and wide, he looks to thrash it down the ground but gets it off the inside half of the bat to the bowler
This time, he gives it more flight and tosses it up, driven down to long-off
Another yorker-like delivery from the left-arm spinner, and it's squeezed towards cover
Siddharth looks to york him at 116.6kph on leg. He manages to jam his bat down and squeeze it out on the off side
Arya shows he's not all about that power! Shuffles across and paddle-scoops this very fine on the leg side to pick up four more
Tucked through square leg, and he gets two. And that's a half-century off 19 balls! Priyansh Arya has been sensational today, in his strokeplay and intent!
Length ball angled across him, he opens the face to steer it behind point and gets a single as short third cuts it out
Avesh goes back of length and pace off, and Arya waits on it before just punching it through point
Chipped over cover! Avesh overpitches again and Arya gets this over the infielder with an open face. Barely had to move
Full outside off, drives it back at the bowler and nutmegs him. Long-off comes across to keep it to a single
Glorious! Overpitched on off at 135kph and Connolly lofts it handsomely over long-off
Oooh, almost carries to short fine leg. Full outside leg and he tries to swing it away, but it just falls short of the fielder
Full outside off, driven in the gap between cover and mid-off for a single
Tossed up on middle and leg, clipped to long-on
Fired in quicker at 96kph, driven down to long-off
Length ball angled across him, Priyansh slaps it away to the off-side sweeper
On a length and wide of off, still slow at 79kph, cut away to deep point
And now he goes bigger! 'Matchup? What matchup?' asks Cooper Connolly! This is flighted at 74kph and right in the slot. And it was asking to be launched over long-on like that!
Perfect placement. This is flung flat on a length outside off and Connolly drills a drive wide of long-off
That one, he has timed to perfection! Arya has raced to 40 off 13 here with a massive six over midwicket. Another short ball from Mohsin is deposited into the stands. Cracking pull shot

That's gone high in the air and it evades mid-on and mid-off running back! Mistimes this one as he goes for a hoick across the line to this 135kph full ball. Gets a top edge, but it has enough legs to clear the infielders
And now he smashes it over deep fine leg! Mohsin goes short and Arya swivels and pulls this fine on the leg side. Clears the rope with ease. 50 up for PBKS
Helps it along in the gap! This was not a bad ball, but Arya has made the most of it. Length ball on off, and he just whips it fine along the ground
Full and straying onto his pads, Connolly misses out with an attempted flick. The ball ricochets through point off his pads
On a length outside off, tucked through midwicket
Well, he's timed the bones out of that one! Short ball angled across him again, but he picks the length early. Stands tall and swats it away flat over midwicket
Full outside off, drilled to mid-on. The pressure building with five dot balls on the trot
Short and wide, he looks for a pull and is beaten
Looks for the wide yorker and does a good job of it too. Connolly looks to squeeze it away but can't connect
On a length around off and angled across, punched to cover
Short and wide, has Connolly flashing at it but he can't connect

Skies this one too, and into the stands! Mohsin goes for another short ball, this time sliding down leg a little more. He gets much better connection on this one with a similar shot and it goes sailing over the deep backward square fielder

Another one goes high in the air but lands safe! This is a back of length delivery outside off at 140kph. Arya has a short-arm jab at it and it goes high over square leg. The fielder is running back and deep backward square is running across but it lands in no man's land
On a length outside off, tucked towards mid-on
Hits high on the bat, pops up but doesn't carry to midwicket! The short ball just outside off hurried Connolly, and cramped him for room
Edged, and there's no slip fielder! Length ball, wide of off and Connolly slashes at this wobble seam delivery. Gets enough of it to beat Pant's dive, and it's well fine of short third
Mohsin continues to create chances. This is a length ball close to off, and Connolly looks to whip it away leg side. Gets an inside edge onto the pads and nearly lobs back to the bowler
Length ball outside leg, goes off the pads towards square leg
Length ball angled across, eased through point
Flashed fine of deep third Throws his bat at this short and wide delivery and it goes over and wide of gully. Deep third stood no chance as that was absolutely flying
Another outswinger on a length around middle and leg. Nice push but he can't quite find the gap at cover's right. Good fielding there to save three runs
Length ball on middle and it beats the edge as he pushes at it. This was shaping away across the left-hander
Hammered over mid-off! Short ball sits up nicely and he hits a flat-batted shot, getting it well over the infield
Pitched up, but with pace off. Connolly looks to drive it back past the bowler but hits it uppishly and is lucky Mohsin can't catch that to his right
On a length around off, 140ks, Connolly blocks
Big shout for lbw as Mohsin angles one in and beats Connolly's flick. There were two noises, and Pant also suggests it was likely going down leg side. No bat though, replays confirm
Swish and a miss. On a length outside off, hint of shape away, and Connolly pushes at it in vain
Tucked off his pads through square leg
Cracking shot over midwicket! Back of length outside off and it seams in slightly. He picks the length early, stands tall and swings it away for a six
And we have the first boundary of the day. Shami strays onto his pads and Connolly plays a lovely flick through midwicket
Oh, this is lovely stuff from Shami! This is another seam-up delivery that angles in but swings away late to beat Connolly's drive away from his body
On a length outside off, it holds its line. Connolly leaves it alone

First-ball duck for Prabhsimran Singh, and it's a trademark Shami dismissal! Perfect outswinger outside off, with that upright seam, and Prabhsimran goes fishing and gets a thick edge. The ball flies to Mitch Marsh at slip who takes it comfortably
On a length on middle, he taps it to mid-on and gets a single
Short and wide, Arya flashes at it but can't connect
Length ball on middle angled across, punched defensively to cover
Shami starts off with a full delivery down leg. There was swing into the left-hander
LSG finish with 200 but finish 54 short. Wide and slow on a length, Himmat swiped across and got it to the bowler's left. Went at pace and deflected off the hands to the left. Tough chance if at all
They finally take one. Stoinis at long-on gets behind it and takes it on the lower side. Wide and full ball, Markram looked to launch it off side again. Got it off the bottom
Wide and full, slashes to look over cover. Ball goes over third and bat slips out to square leg

Ponting cam's back as PBKS fluff their fourth chance. Keeper ran towards backward point, deep-backward point and deep third run in too. They were have in Prabh's sight as he ran back and the ball swerved, he reached out and the ball went through the gloves. Markram looked to go off side
Wide on a length, pulled to long-on
Short just outside off, pulled to deep midwicket
Yorker on leg, whipped over the bowler. Long-on comes in and cleans up. Markram not happy his partner didn't return
Bouncer around head-height beats the pull

Shashank should stop fielding and go take over the live blog. Third drop. Easiest of the lot. Came in and to the right from deep square leg, couldn't get behind it. Wrong-footed, reached to the left and spilled it off the fingers. Shreyas was smiling as it went up, turned away and laughed. Was a back of length ball on leg, pulled off the top edge
Yorker around off, jammed to long-on
You could tell that's wide from the way the keeper ran in after taking it low. 118ks slower bouncer beat the pull went over head
Shin-high wide full toss. Markram gets his weight well forward, waits for the ball to arrive next to him and slaps it through point
Wide and high-ish, guided over third
Wide-ish yorker is jammed to mid-off

Proper misjudgement from Shashank again! He thought it sailed well over him but was a feet or so over him. Ball hit the cushion on the full, he could've thought he was much closer to to it too. Anyway, Ricky Ponting is expressionless, gets the single teapot going too. Was full and wide, launched over cover
Similar ball, touch fuller if anything. Choudhary reaches out again and manages to pat it with an open face to deep-backward point

Was petrified we might not have it but thankfully the wide review's here. Wide yorker, Choudhary was slightly across and looked to slice it behind point. The ball is... just inside the revised tramline
Swing for long-on, get four to deep third. Arshdeep still not getting reverse, full ball angles away outside off. Choudhary looks to go over long-off and gets an outside edge
Short ball too quick. 134ks, angling away outside off. Choudhary bends his elbows as he pulls and misses
Yorker outside leg, beats Markram's swing. Hits pad and goes off side. Great ball for a free hit

Vyshak nails it again... and gets penalised. Third short ball of the over. This was definitely head height. Vyshak is confused, talks to the ump. Likely to indicate he didn't know about the two warnings. Nothing doing though. He has to concede. Markram went for the pull and was beaten
And Markram can't check his pull, but he's too early on it like Choudhary. Vyshak going slow and short
Another bouncer, slower one. 110ks. Choudhary got on one knee and had to check the pull to square leg
Helicopter No. 3 connects. To the ball designed for it too. Missed yorker, the full ball on middle and leg was whipped over long-on
Choudhary shapes to pull, then looks to upper cut over third. Misses both. The short ball went away from him, extra height beat him.
Low, low full toss just outside off. 132ks. Markram has to lunge low to sweep it to long-on
Back to nailing yorkers we are. Jammed to long-on
Bartlett misses his length on the full side. Seam-up full toss on the front thigh, Markram tonks it through the line over wide long-on
Wide on a length, pulled with ease over wide long-on. That's how early he picked and hit it
Another helicopter-y finish, this time to a pull that rolls to long-on. Not timed again. 118ks
Another yorker, punched to the off side with limited timing
Wide yorker at pace. Choudhary gets on one knee and looks to give the cover drive a helicopter flick. Bat turns in hand and ball rolls to cover
Length outside off, punched through point
Pitched up, so Markram looks to slog it across the line. Inside edge goes through square leg
Another bouncer, this is chest-high, pulled to deep midwicket
Bouncer from around the wicket at pace. Head-high, Choudhary ducks under it

Luck not enough for Pooran. Slot ball but without change in arm speed. Off the knuckle at 118ks around middle and leg, Pooran was out of the crease and beside the ball as he looked to launch it down the ground. Swung a touch too early. Shreyas ran in from long-off and took it behind the stumps around about. Pooran tosses his bat and catches it as he walks back in disappointment. Horror season so far
Flicks the 114ks length ball to deep square leg
Length on leg, flicked to deep midwicket

Shashank shells it! The ball was in the air for an age, Shashank stood still for most of the ball's journey, took a step and then two to the right. Turns out it was too late. Don't think ball touched hand. Was another full ball from Chahal on leg, Pooran got on one knee and swivelled as he went for the slog sweep. Went off the bottom of the bat
Looked like another slider. Rushes it to a full length around off stump, Markram drives off the inside-half to long-on
Full again, legbreak is jammed to long-on
Very full and on the slower side, pushed to the bowler
Slider. Front of the hand stuff. Length ball on middle, Markram shapes to cut and is cramped for room. Jams the bat, inside edges the ball to the leg side

Brilliant upper cut! Pooran saw the bouncer, started to limbo to the leg side at first, then realised the ball was close enough to him to lift his bat over his left shoulder and get it fine. Above the first-slip area
Fullish length ball on off, flicked uppishly at first, it then rolls to long-on. 139ks

Keeper catch. Given. Pant chats with Pooran and... reviews. Yorker landing just outside the crease around sixth stump. Pant's knee was on the ground and facing cover as he reached out, opened the bat face and looked to slice it. Ball was too low, Pant's grip weakened and outside edge hit the ground with the ball close to bat. Hard to tell what it hit from the audio... but what about sight? It does lead to a conclusive answer as there is a deflection away. Easy catch for the keeper. Arshdeep's finger went up straight away
Slot ball. Arshdeep looking for reverse but not finding any. Seam pointing to fine leg and the full ball went to leg, Pooran got on one knee and miscud it through midwicket. Stopped in the deep
Down leg, pitched up and Pooran goes for a slog sweep. Misses
Pitched up on leg, flicked to deep midwicket. Finishes just past the ring, deep fielder comes in, can't stop two. 138ks
Pitched right up, punched to long-on

Out if it landed in line. Big lbw appeal turned down. Prabhsimran comes in for a chat with Chahal, Shreyas walks in too. PBKS review. Was a length ball that hit Pooran on the back thigh. His knee was on the ground as he went for the big slog sweep. Hawk-Eye's in, shows that landed just outside leg
Full on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
One-handed six over long-on! Slot ball tossed up on off, Pant clears the front leg and raises the bat from down to up. Chahal signals an apology to the skip

Shreyas last game, Priyansh now, is it? Priyansh not celebrating as this is sent upstairs. Replay shows why. His right foot pushed into the cushion as he stepped and then bounced over the ropes. He tossed the ball back to Jansen, who ran in from long-on. Was a length ball at the stumps, Pant got his weight forward and slog swept it with a big wind-up and follow-through. Just enough for a six to midwicket
Length on leg, low bounce and perhaps pace too, flicked softly through square leg

Marsh exasperates on one knee, smiles in resignation as his tough stay ends. 86ks legbreak with a lot of revs, lands on the fuller side of length wide of off, Marsh got on one knee and looked to sweep it straight. Got it flat and straight to long-on

Superb defensive bowling, all over and to finish. 135ks wide yorker a few inches inside the tramline. Landed close to if not on the crease. Pant didn't move across, reached out and looked to go through cover. Bat goes under bat again
Slower one. Knuckle ball in fact. On a length outside off, Pant looks to mow it across the line, crouches as he loses the bottom hand and the ball goes under bat
Goes for the yorker, not nailed but it finds the toe of the bat as Marsh hits through the line. Finds long-on
Banged short, loses a lot pace... no, it was slow to start. 115ks. Outside off, beaten on the pull. Went well under the bat
Vyshak appeals for lbw, gets nothing. Replay shows that hit the bat's toe before going onto Pant's thigh and dribbling towards point. Pant looked to launch that over mid-on off a length
Bouncer goes the other side and is pulled through midwicket. Around shoulder-height, angling away and going slow. Pant loads up, crosses his legs and hits into the ground
Pant's beaten on the pull. He swivelled, the head turned off side and he lost balance while swinging. The shortish ball went just down leg
Floated on leg, Pant walks out and is only able to help it leg side for a single
Full around leg, eased down to long-on
Length ball angled across, and Pant meets it with an ungainly hoick out to deep midwicket
On a length outside off, punched out to deep cover
Floated full on leg, clipped square on the leg side
Chahal takes it away from Pant's arc, who can only chop it towards cover point
Shaped for the scoop, but realised he couldn't get under it. Ends up working it to short fine leg for a single
Full around off, driven to long-off
Length ball on middle, cramping Pant for room. Cut away to deep point
Goes for the slower bouncer, but it's too short
Full outside off, driven down to long-off
Pant jumps down to this slower short ball and slaps it down to long-off
Low full toss sliding down leg, punched to long-on
Vyshak runs in and bumps it in short, and Marsh just watches it sail over him. Wide called immediately
Short and wide, Marsh goes across and chops it towards point for a single
Marsh now gets a stride forward to Chahal and smokes him over midwicket! Slot ball slogged away
Looks to play a paddle sweep but it balloons up off his gloves. Doesn't go far enough to short fine leg, who was running in
Tossed up full around off and drifting away, Pant looks to slog it away but miscues it. Gets it in the gap between deep midwicket and deep square leg
Tossed full on middle, Pant eases this through midwicket and they race for two
Starts with a short-ish ball outside off, Marsh can only hit a grounded pull to long-on
Now Pant tries to get cute with a reverse-scoop but can't connect as Jansen took the pace off. Good over nonetheless for LSG
And there's the one-handed six we were here to see! Dances down to this full ball and launches it over the sightscreen
Rishabh Pant, hello! It's a slot ball and Pant deals with it as such. Bosched over long-on
Jansen bangs it in short and Marsh doesn't get all of it on the pull. The ball balloons up but the midwicket region is vacant
Short and angling into Pant at 140kph, he pulls it away along the ground to deep backward square
Length ball angling into him, swung away to deep square leg

Vyshak gets the breakthrough! He follows up his yorker barrage with a full ball outside off, just wide enough to make Badoni reach out to try and whip it over the leg side. Badoni tries to do that anyway, and only ends up hitting it to midwicket. Powerplay ends with LSG on 61 for 1
Another good wide yorker, at 111kph, and Badoni can only jam this to cover
Nails the wide yorker. He can't squeeze this away
Good yorker, but Marsh is able to squeeze it away
Yorker on middle and off, clipped wide of long-on
Badoni's fine start continues. This is overpitched outside off and he just opens his face to square drive this through the vacant point region
Full around middle, tapped towards midwicket for a quick run
Badoni continues to impress here. Jansen overpitches and Badoni hits a lovely straight drive giving mid-off no chance
Smartly played. Badoni shuffles across to this full slower ball around off and scoops it fine on the leg side
Marsh looks to swing away this length ball outside leg but doesn't connect
Full outside off, driven to mid-off
Short and wide, cut away to deep point

This time, Marsh nails the straight drive! He hit this better than the last ball, and beats Bartlett. Arshdeep at long-on comes across and puts in the dive and gets a hand on it, but the ball rolls onto the rope anyway
135kph yorker around middle, Marsh gives it a push back with an open face. Bartlett does well to get down and stop it from going through
Full outside off, pace off, and Badoni is early into the shot. Ends up hitting it uppishly to mid-off's left

Badoni flashes at a full and wide delivery and it goes flying just over the backward point fielder! Deep point ran across, and Arya should have stopped that, but couldn't get low enough in time and the ball slips through
Badoni, that was some shot! Full around off and he hits a lofted straight drive to perfection!
Full outside off, he looks to heave it away. Can only hit it grounded to midwicket

Now that's a superb shot! This is overpitched and Marsh meets it with the full face of the bat, driving it perfectly between mid-off and mid-on. Both fielders thought they could catch up with it, but the ball kept gathering pace
Oh, Arshdeep bowls a beautiful inswinger and Marsh just about manages to get his bat down. The contact is enough, however, to send it rolling to the fine leg fence
Runs back a long way and Iyer can't hold on. Marsh looks to take on this full delivery but miscues this lofted drive. Iyer runs back from mid-off but can't quite get under it to catch it cleanly
Another full insweinger, flicked away through midwicket and Vyshak gives chase and keeps it down to two
Arshdeep nails an inswinging yorker aimed at the base of off stump. Badoni just about manages to keep that out. Arshdeep gives him a glare
And Badoni gets going now! Length ball angled across and he frees his arms and bashes this wide of mid-on
Marsh happy to shoulder arms again as Bartlett bowls another outswinger
On a length outside off and shaping away, 135kph, Marsh has a think and shoulders arms
Full outside off and Marsh looks for a booming drive, but he ends up slicing it over point. Manages to clear the infielders though
Aaaand away we go! Back of length ball angling down leg sits up ever so nicely and that's a shot Marsh loves to play as he picks it up over backward square leg with a pull
Skips out and bunts this length ball back to the bowler
On a length outside off, tapped towards short third for a single
This length ball flies down leg for a wide
Very full around off, squeezed out in front
Another one length ball angled across, Badoni clips it aerially out to deep square leg
Another length ball angled across, Badoni pats it down again

Big appeal, and umpire says no. Shreyas Iyer has a chat with Prabhsimran and they opt against the review. Cracking inswinger, very full around leg, and swinging back in a long way. Badoni did get bat on it though so good call to not review it!
Outswinger on a length on leg angling across him, Badoni parries it down
Full on leg, tucked in front of square and LSG are off the mark
